title: Build a newsletter chatbot in PHP - Part 1
content:
<html><head></head><body>Email has been a great channel for staying in touch with your audience for years. But times are changing and messengers are taking over communication. Let's see how I used Facebook Messenger to build a little newsletter bot for my book "Build Chatbots with PHP".
            </body></html>
